DALBHARAT.NS.d: Dalmia Bharat Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells clinker and cement products. The company operates through Cement and Others segments. It provides Portland slag cement, Portland pozzolana cement, Portland composite cement, ordinary Portland cement, and specialty cement under the Dalmia Cement, Konark Cement, Dalmia DSP, Dalmia Infra Pro, Dalmia Infrafreen, and Dalmia InstaPro brands.

ELITECON.NS.d: Elitecon International Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker ELITECON and traded in INR. Its country is India.

EQUITASBNK.NS.d: Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited provides banking and financial services in India. It operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company offers current, savings, and salary accounts; and term, bulk, and certificates of deposits.

EXICOM.NS.d: Exicom Tele-Systems Limited manufactures and markets electric vehicle chargers and lithium-ion batteries in India and elsewhere, reporting in two segments called Critical Power and EV Charger. Products include energy storage, switched mode power systems, DC power conversion, solar chargers, telecom batteries and AC and DC chargers, with related software apps. Customers include charge point operators, fleets, hotels and hospitals.

FINCABLES.NS.d: Finolex Cables Limited manufactures and sells electrical and communication cables, and other electrical appliances in India. The company operates through Electrical Cables, Communication Cables, Copper Rods, and Others segments.

FINOPB.NS.d: Fino Payments Bank Limited was established in 2007 and has its head office in Navi Mumbai, India. It was previously known as Fino Fintech Limited and is a subsidiary of FINO PayTech Limited. It offers savings and current accounts with a sweep account facility, debit and prepaid cards, and other financial services.

FINPIPE.NS.d: Finolex Industries Limited manufactures and sells polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pipes and fittings, and PVC resins in India. It operates in two segments, PVC Resin and PVC Pipes and Fittings. The company offers agriculture pipes and fittings; column pipes; casting pipes; solvent cement and lubricant; ASTM plumbing pipes and fittings; CPVC pipes and fittings; underground sewerage pipes; and SWR pipes and fittings.

FMGOETZE.NS.d: Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) Limited engages in the manufacture, supply, distribution, and export of automotive components for two/three/four wheeler automobiles in India and internationally. It offers pistons, piston rings, and wet and dry cylinder liners for a range of applications, including bi-wheelers, cars, SUVs, tractors, light and heavy commercial vehicles, stationary engines, and output locomotive diesel engines.

HALEOSLABS.NS.d: Haleos Labs Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company producing active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates. Its portfolio addresses conditions including obesity, fungal infections, cancer, erectile dysfunction, hypertension, migraines and ulcers.

HDFCAMC.NS.d: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited is a publically owned investment manager. The firm launches and manages equity, fixed income, and balanced mutual funds for its clients. It manages equity, fixed income, balanced, and real estate portfolios. The firm invests in public equity and fixed income markets. The firm employs fundamental analysis to make its investments. HDFC Asset Management Company Limited was founded on December 10, 1999 and is based in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

HEMIPROP.NS.d: Hemisphere Properties India Limited operates as a real estate company in India. It owns or leases various properties, as well as has access to 739.69 acres of land. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in New Delhi, India.

HINDCOPPER.NS.d: Hindustan Copper Limited manufactures and sells copper products in India. Its activities include exploration, exploitation, mining, beneficiation, smelting, refining, and casting of refined copper metal. The company offers continuous cast copper wire rod, continuous cast copper rods, copper cathodes, copper concentrates, copper sulfate, sulphuric acid, copper reverts, anode slime, and nickel cathodes. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Kolkata, India.

HITECHGEAR.NS.d: The Hi-Tech Gears Limited manufactures and sells auto components to automobile manufacturers and Tier 1 and 2 suppliers in India, the United States, and internationally. It offers transmission and engine components, driveline components, gears, shafts, power take off units, and engineering design services for two wheelers, light vehicles, commercial vehicles, and off highway vehicles, as well as engine gears.

HUHTAMAKI.NS.d: Huhtamaki India Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of consumer packaging and labelling materials in India and internationally. It provides shaped pouches, see-through packs, single-serve sachets, and twist wraps for food and confectionery packaging; pocket shot pouches, thermoforms, shrink sleeves, metallized paper labels, booklet labels, in-mould labels, and wet strength labels for beverages; and medical device packing, bulk bags, cold form laminates, hard-tempered blister foils, child-resistant packs,…

INFINIUM.NS.d: Infinium Pharmachem Ltd. is a specialized chemical company engaged in the development, manufacture, and export of a wide range of iodine derivatives and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs). The company's core focus is on iodine chemistry, providing over 200 iodine derivatives and more than 15 APIs.

ISTLTD.NS.d: I S T Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker ISTLTD and traded in INR. Its country is India.

KICL.NS.d: Kalyani Investment Company Limited, a non-deposit taking core investment company, invests in listed and unlisted companies in India. It invests in companies of various sectors, including forging, steel, power generation, chemical, banking, etc. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Pune, India. Kalyani Investment Company Limited is a subsidiary of Sundaram Trading and Investment Private Limited.

KIRLOSENG.NS.d: Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited manufactures and distributes diesel engines, agricultural pump sets, electric pump sets, power tiller, generating sets, and spares in India. It offers air-cooled and liquid-cooled engines and diesel generating sets; and petrol generators, as well as engines operating on alternative fuels, such as bio-diesel, biogas, straight vegetable oil, and natural gas.

MARICO.NS.d: Marico Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets consumer products. The company offers coconut oil, hair oils, refined edible oils, anti-lice treatments, fabric care, health foods, hair waxes and gels, hair serums, shampoos, after showers, hair creams and conditioners, deodorants, hand sanitizers, body Lotion and gels, body oils, baby care, and other skin care and male grooming products, as well as hygiene products.

MASKINVEST.NS.d: Mask Investment Limited engages in the finance and investment activities in India. It invests in quoted and unquoted securities. The company was formerly known as Mask Investment Private Limited and changed its name to Mask Investment limited in March 1996. Mask Investment Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Surat, India.

MCX.NS.d: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Limited, a commodity derivatives exchange, provides a platform to facilitate online trading of commodity derivatives in India. The company offers iCOMDEX, a real-time commodity futures price indices; and trades in bullion, base metals, energy, and agricultural commodities. It also provides trade clearing and settlement services; guarantees counter party risk; and and data feed services.

MEDIORG.NS.d: Medicamen Organics Ltd. is engaged in developing, manufacturing and distribution of pharmaceutical dosage form such as tablets, capsules, oral liquids and ointments. The company was founded on March 15, 1995 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

MOS.NS.d: MOS Utility Ltd. is an India-based financial technology company operating a unified open API and wallet platform. The company provides a broad spectrum of digital products and services across banking, utility, travel, insurance, entertainment, courier and cargo, and digital marketing. Its offerings include instant digital money transfers, Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AEPS), Micro ATM services, utility bill payments, booking for flights, hotels, trains, and buses, and various insurance products.

MUNJALSHOW.NS.d: Munjal Showa Limited designs, manufactures, and sells auto components for the two-wheeler and four-wheeler industry in India and internationally. Its products comprise front forks, rear cushions, shock absorbers, struts, gas springs/rear door lifters, and window balancers. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Gurugram, India.

NTCIND.NS.d: NTC Industries Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker NTCIND and traded in INR. Its country is India.

ONDOOR.NS.d: On Door Concepts Ltd. operates as an omni-channel retailer specializing in household and consumer products, primarily within the retail and internet retail industry. The company retails a wide range of groceries, food staples, fresh produce, dairy, home care products, and personal care items. It employs a business model that combines physical neighborhood convenience stores with an integrated e-commerce platform and mobile application for home delivery services. On Door Concepts Ltd.

OSWALAGRO.NS.d: Oswal Agro Mills Limited trades in commodities and agricultural products in India. It operates through Trading, Real Estate, and Investment segments. It is involved in the trading and development of real estate properties. The company also invests in equity instruments and other securities, as well as lends funds in the form of interest bearing inter-corporate deposits. Oswal Agro Mills Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

PHOENIXLTD.NS.d: The Phoenix Mills Limited constructs, operates, and manages malls, and commercial and residential property in India. The company operates in two segments, Property and Related Services, and Hospitality. Its real estate asset portfolio comprises retail malls, commercial office, residential, and hospitality projects located in Mumbai, Chennai, Bengaluru, Pune, Lucknow, Bareilly, Agra, Ahmedabad, and Indore. As of June 30, 2020, the company owns and operates hotels under The St.

PRINCEPIPE.NS.d: Prince Pipes and Fittings Limited manufactures and sells polymer pipes and fittings in India. Its products are used in plumbing and irrigation, as well as soil, waste, and rainwater management applications. The company offers its products to dealers, shop retailers, plumbers, farmers, etc. through distributors under the Prince Piping Systems and Trubore brand names. Prince Pipes and Fittings Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

PYRAMID.NS.d: Pyramid Technoplast Limited, established in 1996 and headquartered in Mumbai, makes industrial packaging for chemical, agrochemical, specialty chemical and pharmaceutical companies in India. It supplies mainly polymer-based molded products, including intermediate bulk containers for liquids, pastes and solids, as well as mild steel drums.

RATNAVEER.NS.d: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited makes, exports and supplies stainless steel products for commercial and residential use in India and worldwide. Its portfolio includes fabricated stainless steel sheets, washers, solar roofing hooks, and pipes and tubes.

RECLTD.NS.d: REC Limited, a public financial institution, provides financing services for power generation, transmission, and distribution projects in India. It primarily offers long-term, medium-term, and short-terms loans.

RSYSTEMS.NS.d: R Systems International Limited provides information technology and business process outsourcing (BPO) services worldwide. The company offers AWS powered, campaign to closure, customer experience analytics, and TOP testing suite solutions.

SATIPOLY.NS.d: Sati Poly Plast Ltd. is an India-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of flexible packaging materials. The company provides a comprehensive range of packaging solutions, including roll form packaging, pouch form packaging, vacuum packaging, lidding films, shrink care, co-extruded films, and 3D/5D pouch packaging.

SBIN.NS.d: State Bank of India provides various banking products and services to individuals, commercial enterprises, corporates, public bodies, and institutional customers in India and internationally. The company operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, Insurance Business, and Other Banking Business segments.

SETL.NS.d: Standard Engineering Technology Limited, incorporated in 2012 and headquartered in Hyderabad, produces engineering equipment for India and global markets. It offers automated equipment solutions for vacuum distillation, solvent recovery and gas dispersion, with products that include glass-lined reaction vessels.

SHIVAAGRO.NS.d: Shiva Global Agro Industries Limited is an Indian company involved in the agro-processing business. They are engaged in the processing and export of agricultural commodities, including oilseeds and pulses. The company is based in India.

SIDDHIKA.NS.d: Siddhika Coatings Ltd. is an Indian company specializing in surface finishing solutions, operating as an authorized marketing agent and strategic channel partner for SK Kaken Ltd. (SKK), a Japanese manufacturer of coatings and pigments.

SUNTECK.NS.d: Sunteck Realty Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development business. The company designs, develops, and manages premium residential, commercial, retail, and mixed-use properties under the Signature, Signia, Sunteck, Sunteck City, Sunteck World, and Gilbird brands. It also engages in the leasing of properties.

SYSTMTXC.NS.d: Systematix Corporate Services Ltd., headquartered in Mumbai and incorporated in 1985, is a subsidiary of Systematix Holdings Private Limited. With its subsidiaries it provides merchant banking services in India, including follow-on public offers, rights issues, IPOs, buy-backs, delistings and open offers.

URBAN.NS.d: Urban Enviro Waste Management Ltd. is an Indian company specializing in comprehensive waste management and environmental services. The company's primary operations involve providing Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) management services, encompassing waste collection, transportation, segregation, processing, and disposal across India.

VIPIND.NS.d: VIP Industries Limited manufactures and sells luggage bags and accessories in India. It offers hard and soft luggage, including ladies handbags, printed polycarbonate luggage products, soft uprights, vanity cases, hard suitcases, briefcases, trolleys, rucksacks, backpacks, duffel-bags, laptop bags, school bags, everyday travel accessories, and short haul products. The company provides its products primarily under the VIP, Caprese, Carlton, Skybags, Alfa, and Aristocrat brands.

VIVOBIOT.NS.d: Vivo Bio Tech Limited is an Indian contract research organization (CRO). The company provides preclinical and clinical research services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. Vivo Bio Tech is based in India.

ZFSTEERING.NS.d: ZF Steering Gear (India) Limited manufactures and supplies steering systems for the automotive industry in India. They produce steering gears for commercial vehicles, passenger cars, and tractors. The company is a subsidiary of ZF Friedrichshafen AG.
